## MUBA change checklist

- [ ] Work is isolated from the current stable production baseline.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] User-facing change: a new entry was added to `muba_history.json`.
- [ ] Existing history entries were not deleted or rewritten.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, sessions or private IDs were committed.
- [ ] Merge only after required checks are green.

Permanent operating rule: **BAŞLA 🔥 MERGE 🟢 SİSTEMİ KORU 🛡️ STABİL 🔒**
